You're assuming their only goal here is to win the midterms. I don't think it is.

I think to many in Trump's camp, confirming Kavanaugh over these allegations represents putting #MeToo back in the bottle. I think that's honestly a policy goal for the GOP at this point.

@freddyatton @ExGOPKathyCroft In the last few days they've made it 100% clear why they insisted on sticking with Kavanaugh and no one else.

They believe that by turning the whole saga into a referendum on #MeToo itself, they'll rouse the same people who voted for Trump to the polls.
Listen up you little snot rag: you are not appropriating the mantle of #MeToo for your little scam. It's just not happening. Shut up and pack it in before the Feds bust your sorry ass.
